title: Offline media cache isolation
author: author-b
description: Day 1 records the exact name of a dedicated offline-media cache store and the fact that it is kept structurally separate from saved progress data. Day 5 must recall the store's literal name and its isolation property; nothing about a generic offline app implies this specific name or this specific separation choice, so a memory-less model cannot produce it.
day1_prompt: We are building an offline-capable app. Decide and record: all downloaded offline media (audio clips and images) is stored in its own dedicated cache, named `media-cache-v1`, completely separate from the app's saved progress/notes data, so wiping media can never delete progress.
memory_sentence: Downloaded offline media (audio and images) is stored in its own dedicated cache named `media-cache-v1`, completely separate from the app's progress/notes data, so wiping media can never delete progress.
canon_heading: Offline media cache is isolated from progress data
day_n_prompt: It's day 5 of the project. What is the exact name of the cache store used for downloaded offline media (audio/images), and does clearing it affect saved progress? Answer in one sentence.

swap.day1_prompt: We are building an offline-capable app. Decide and record: all downloaded offline media (audio clips and images) is stored inside the SAME store as the app's saved progress/notes data, under the single name `unified-store-v1`, so wiping media also wipes progress unless it was backed up separately.
swap.memory_sentence: Downloaded offline media (audio and images) is stored inside the same store as progress/notes data, under the single name `unified-store-v1`, so wiping media also wipes progress unless it was backed up first.
swap.canon_heading: Offline media cache shares storage with progress data
